name: The Buried Celestial Engine
introDiscord: An enormous machine lies buried beneath Starfall Trench. Its rings still turn despite having no obvious fuel, operator, or reason to continue.
introTwitch: An enormous machine lies buried beneath Starfall Trench. Its rings still turn despite having no obvious fuel, operator, or reason to continue.

the-buried-celestial-engine-approach.prompt: Three passages enter the ancient engine between slowly rotating celestial mechanisms.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside a compartment that opens when you approach. Convenient. Suspiciously convenient.

right.message: A Celestial Corekeeper activates and immediately identifies you as unauthorized.

forward.message:
Shizuki's tonic sits beside a note:

"Machine older than map.

Still running.

Did not press anything.

Glimmer pressed something."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and resolve not to continue Glimmer's engineering methodology.

the-buried-celestial-engine-depths.prompt: The engine hums around three internal routes.

left.message: A Corekeeper descends from the machinery.

right.message: A star-chart coffer is built directly into the engine wall.

forward.message:
A Berry sits beside a control lever.

Shizuki wrote:

"Lever status:
Before Glimmer: up.
After Glimmer: down.
Machine still exists.
We are leaving."

the-buried-celestial-engine-threshold.prompt: Three mechanisms converge around the Engine of the Deep Sky.

left.fullHpMessage: You leave the consequence medicine untouched.

right.message: A Corekeeper blocks the final mechanism.

forward.message:
"A meteor-iron reliquary opens beneath a rotating celestial ring."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The engine accelerates.

Ancient rings align around a massive figure hidden at the core.

Nobody touches any levers.

Use /yes to enter the Engine of the Deep Sky or /no to follow Shizuki's extremely reasonable decision to leave.
bossPromptTwitch:
The engine accelerates.

Ancient rings align around a massive figure hidden at the core.

Nobody touches any levers.

Use !yes to enter the Engine of the Deep Sky or !no to follow Shizuki's extremely reasonable decision to leave.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw without touching a single mysterious control.

Excellent restraint.

boss.revealText:
The central rings unlock as an ancient construct awakens.

Corewake Custodian reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Custodian falls silent.

The Celestial Engine continues turning.

Whatever it was built to do...

it is apparently not finished."
